prompt: I'm getting a build error: 'incremental compilation: could not create session directory lock file'. What causes this and how do I fix it? Also, I need to know the proper way to bump the app version before doing a release build.

assertions.name: identifies-wsl-root-cause
assertions.description: Answer identifies WSL filesystem as the root cause of the incremental compilation error

assertions.name: mentions-cargo-incremental
assertions.description: Answer mentions CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 as a fix

assertions.name: mentions-cargo-target-dir
assertions.description: Answer mentions CARGO_TARGET_DIR as an alternative fix

assertions.name: mentions-two-version-files
assertions.description: Answer mentions that version must be updated in both Cargo.toml and tauri.conf.json

assertions.name: mentions-build-menu-script
assertions.description: Answer mentions build-menu.ps1 as the recommended way to bump the version
